queries:
WITH type_avg AS (
    SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount != 0
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type,
       avg_ratio,
       avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM type_avg) AS diff_from_mean
FROM type_avg;
WITH type_avg AS (
    SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type, avg_ratio, ABS(avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM type_avg)) AS abs_diff
FROM type_avg;
WITH type_avg AS (
    SELECT e.type AS type,
           AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / b.amount) AS avg_ratio
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL
      AND b.amount IS NOT NULL
      AND b.amount <> 0
    GROUP BY e.type
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg FROM type_avg
)
SELECT t.type,
       t.avg_ratio,
       t.avg_ratio - o.mean_avg AS diff_from_mean,
       (t.avg_ratio - o.mean_avg) * 100.0 / o.mean_avg AS diff_percentage
FROM type_avg t
CROSS JOIN overall o;
WITH t AS (
    SELECT e.type AS type, SUM(b.spent) * 1.0 / SUM(b.amount) AS ratio
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type,
       ratio,
       ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM t) AS diff_from_mean
FROM t;
